newsitem.title: USA: WestPoint Stevens names new president.
newsitem.headline: WestPoint Stevens names new president.

text.p: WestPoint Stevens Inc said on Monday that Joseph Jennings Jr, the current president and chief operating officer, will become vice chairman of the board.
Vice chairman of the board is a newly-created position.
Thomas Ward, the company's executive vice president of sales and marketing, will become president and chief operating officer, the company said.
The position changes will become effective January 1, 1997, WestPoint Stevens said.

Holcombe T. Green Jr, chairman and chief executive officer of WestPoint Stevens said, Jennings will continue "as an integral part of our senior management team, reporting directly to me, but will no longer have the burden of daily operations. This was entirely Mr. Jennings' decision based upon personal reasons."
